\caption{Qualitative results on RefCOCO testA (W2 test, Qwen3.5-9B): random examples 1–3 and failure examples 1–2 of the pre-registered sample. Columns: (1) image with the B-spline written by the LLM (white dots: control points; dotted: control polygon; solid: the closed uniform cubic B-spline; dashed: the proposed box, inside which the curve is clamped before rasterization), labelled with the IoU of the spline's direct rasterization; (2) X-2's final mask after snapping (spline-seeded GrabCut; when the spline cannot be parsed, X-2 falls back to the first candidate mask, as marked); (3) the ellipse control (the inscribed ellipse of the same proposed box, same snapping); (4) ground truth. IoU is per expression, scored as in W2 (a failed pipeline counts as an empty mask). Sampling (pre-registered, U-5): in each split, 40 expressions are drawn without replacement from its 300-expression subset with numpy.random.default\_rng(20260929 + k), k = the split's index (0–4); the random examples are the first 3 drawn, the failure examples the 2 with the lowest X-2 IoU in the pool (ties broken by id). No example was hand-picked or replaced. Data: existing per-expression outputs of RUN-0092 (X-2 and the ellipse control; the spline control points from the same run's trace, sha256-checked); ground truth from the RefCOCO annotations. No model was run for this figure.}
